# Go and Kotlin write a gRPC call: a target in another language refuses the
# program before its generator has nothing to write for the call.

! sngl generate --platform=html -o out app.sngl
stderr 'the program calls a gRPC service, which html/none cannot yet: only the Go targets and android can'

! sngl generate --platform=gtk4 --lang=c -o out app.sngl
stderr 'which gtk4/c cannot yet'

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea -o out app.sngl

sngl generate --platform=android -o out app.sngl
exists out/SnglGrpc.kt out/SnglProto.kt

-- app.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import grpc "sngl:grpc"
import ui "sngl:ui"

#[grpc.message("t.Ping")]
struct Ping {
    #[grpc.field(1)]
    n int = 0
}

func ping() async.Result[Ping] {
    return grpc.call[Ping, Ping](server="localhost:50051", method="/t.T/Ping", request={n=1})
}

component main ui.node {
    var n = 0
    ui.button(text="Ping", @click {
        match var p = ping() {
            ok { n = p.n }
            failed { n = -1 }
        }
    })
    ui.text(value="{n}")
}

ui.window {
    main
}
